name: flow-coexist-eval
description: Single-shot eval probe for the-flow + eng-harness-flow COEXISTENCE (plan 032 T203 / AC-11 + AC-13). Drives a throwaway the-flow flight plan to mid-plan, then drives eng-harness-flow alongside it to inject its four fire-hook steps as CHORES into the-flow.json (run /eng-harness-flow --hook <hook>) via real `harness flow` commands, runs the injection twice to prove idempotency, and reports — never self-grading. The deterministic scripts/score-flow-coexist.sh reads the artifacts and decides.
author: AI-Substrate

files.description: The goal brief: build a throwaway the-flow flight plan, drive eng-harness-flow to inject the four fire-hook chores into it, re-inject to prove idempotency, verify visibility, and report faithfully.

Rules: drive the skills' prescribed `harness flow` commands faithfully (no hand-crank), a skill-prescribed error is a finding, independent verification via --json, idempotency by re-injection, no standalone loop.flow.json while the-flow active, throwaway writes only.
Params: harnessSource (where eng-harness-flow is loaded from), theFlowSchema (path to the the-flow flight-plan schema for create).
Structured report: theFlowPath, reinjectedPath, choreHooks, choreCount, idempotent, navNow, loopFileAbsent, railShowsChores, summary, retrospective (dual-layer).
